tasks.short: Collect curbside recyclable materials for designated facilities.

steps.what: Inspect curbside recyclable materials for collection eligibility and immediate handling hazards.
Collect accepted recyclable materials into the correct load for the designated facility.

tasks.design: Retain physical curbside inspection and collection. Check that existing facility instructions in {OPS_SYSTEM} or {DOCS} identify the destination, but do not claim that a records app lifts or safely classifies every material.
tasks.previous_blocker: The main effort is handling varied materials beside roads and collection vehicles.
tasks.enabler_now: No software change is proposed that removes these physical actions.
tasks.still_hard: Contamination, sharp objects, unstable containers and traffic conditions.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize a hazardous or unsuitable collection and stop or seek specialist help.
tasks.altitude: Nothing changes in the workers week or collection decision rights.

reach.task: Describe an unacceptable curbside collection to the responsible team.
reach.learn: Facility acceptance categories and incident referral.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: ordinary software does not perform physical curbside collection or replace situational hazard assessment.

assumptions: Boundary covers curbside inspection and physical collection into a load; route planning, vehicle driving and facility processing are outside and unchanged. No administrative baseline is added.

Collection supervisor supplies collection_area, material_stream and designated_facility; facility lead supplies dated acceptance guidance. Missing or conflicting instructions require direct supervisor clarification. No new structured interface or automatic extraction is proposed.

Check existing native route and facility instructions before considering code. Zero upkeep is justified because no new tool, ongoing process or transferred work is introduced. The physical presence and handling priors are retained.
unknowns: Material streams, roadside conditions and division between collection worker and driver.
research_questions: Would a separate change to handling equipment improve the physical task?

incremental.description: No new system or maintenance work is introduced.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=100 upkeep=0 net=0. Both routine separated recyclables and contaminated curbside loads retain the full inspection and collection effort.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Protect attention for material handling and roadside hazards.
role.ambitious_version: A recycling worker who collects carefully and communicates uncertain or hazardous materials before they enter the wrong stream.
